profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Fidelity Investments

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Leap Program (6 months): Strengthened programming skills by completing training exercises, assessments, and long term projects. Technologies taught included the following:
o OO Applications using Java/J2EE, .NET, C#, UML and XML
o Web application development with Apache Tomcat server, Web Services and Open Source 
technologies (Spring Framework, iBatis ORM)
o RIA development with Silverlight and Ajax
o Database Development using Oracle, SQL and PL/SQL
o Unit Testing with JUnit
o Using Unix/Linux commands

-Health & Welfare: On-going Java Web Application Development & Maintenance for internal tools.

positions.title: Human Resources Information Systems Intern
positions.description:
•Used BI Publisher to code rtf files that were imported into XML Publisher for producing printable PDF reports
•Developed training content modules with Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK) that could facilitate airport departments’ learning of an organizational chart software 
•Performed data integrity checks as necessary to ensure that information was maintained after employee groups were added to HR tables with excel to component interface files
•Generated a variety of recurring ad-hoc reports using Crystal Reports and Excel
•Assisted in creating requested queries using the query manager tool in PeopleSoft
•Assisted in logic modification of an SQR file that needed to reference new HR deduction tables
•Had meetings with HR staff for the purposes of ascertaining their specific project requirements

positions.title: Consulting & Systems Integration Intern
positions.description:
•Assisted various lab managers in basic server installation, commissioning, fiber optic cable testing, hardware configuration, and software installation 
•Implemented and managed a website using Microsoft Office SharePoint 2007 to store and share all on target job documents for a more collective user friendly environment.
•Collected channel testing data and used Microsoft Visio to create menu diagrams for the interface of an IPTV project
